description: This is a PHP source file defining a test fixture class 'LDAPUsersFixture' used for setting up and tearing down LDAP directory entries for testing LDAP integration within the OrangeHRM project. It contains methods for creating, deleting, and managing various organizational units, users, and groups in an LDAP directory, primarily to facilitate unit testing of LDAP-related functionality.

classes.name: LDAPUsersFixture
classes.description: A fixture class to load and clean LDAP directory entries for testing LDAP authentication and directory management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads predefined LDAP entries including organizational units, users, and groups for testing purposes.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes the LDAP entries created by load to clean up the directory.

methods.name: searchAndDelete
methods.description: Searches LDAP entries by distinguished name and query, then deletes them.

methods.name: removeEntity
methods.description: Removes a specific LDAP entry using its Entry object.

methods.name: tryWrapper
methods.description: Wraps LDAP operations with exception handling for LDAP-specific exceptions.

methods.name: createRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Creates root organizational units in LDAP if they do not exist.

methods.name: deleteRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Deletes root organizational units from LDAP.

methods.name: createAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates administrative organizational units and users within LDAP.

methods.name: deleteAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes administrative organizational units and associated users.

methods.name: createSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates sales organizational units and users within LDAP.

methods.name: deleteSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes sales organizational units and associated entries.

methods.name: createLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates a legal organizational unit.

methods.name: deleteLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes the legal organizational unit.

methods.name: createEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates engineering organizational units and users, including a large number of test users.

methods.name: deleteEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes engineering organizational units and test users.

methods.name: createFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates finance organizational unit and users.

methods.name: deleteFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes finance organizational unit and users.

methods.name: createAdminsGroup
methods.description: Creates a group of admin users.

methods.name: deleteAdminsGroup
methods.description: Deletes the admins group.

methods.name: createManagersGroup
methods.description: Creates a managers group.

methods.name: deleteManagersGroup
methods.description: Deletes the managers group.

methods.name: createEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Creates an employees group.

methods.name: deleteEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Deletes the employees group.
